split_groups.rule: Keep both payload episodes and all derived variants in the same train/validation/test split.
Different failure/measurement episodes from the same report remain grouped for split isolation.
Injector plugging and catalyst contamination are distinct episodes but share a test/report family.

note: All ML findings, scores, logs, timestamps, run IDs, spacecraft identifiers and configuration/operational details are synthetic. Public L0 sources constrain historical facts and certainty only. No packet is Gold or training-authorized. One history-reuse task uses the public Cassini RWA case as a partially confirmed, hardware-unknown contrast for the FUSE wheel event; its availability timestamp is conservatively normalized to the end of the NASA LLIS lesson date (2004-05-10). Three additional task-type variants cover evidence_sufficiency, next_step_recommendation and handover_summary. Variants derived from the same source event family remain grouped for future split assignment.
